items.briefing:
Australian organisations are being reminded that home battery systems (such as rooftop solar storage) connected to the internet may now fall under cybersecurity compliance obligations, following new guidance flagged this week. Separately, the rise of AI tools in workplaces is putting pressure on traditional security approaches, with experts warning that AI agents can bypass standard access controls if not carefully managed. Staff should be cautious about which AI tools they use on work devices or with work data.

ScamWatch continues to report active scams targeting Australians across multiple channels. **Practical tip:** If you receive an unexpected message asking you to click a link or provide personal details — even if it appears to come from a trusted source — verify it directly through the organisation's official website or phone number before taking any action.

featured.title: Jamf launches AI Governance to enhance visibility, security
featured.summary: IT teams can now track AI models on Apple fleets to curb data leaks and token spend as businesses wrestle with shadow AI.
